author: veliraiyawrites
title: Looking for fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! 👀 Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me 😂 See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! 🤍 For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I’m definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I’m pretty open stylistically! It’s a very visual world, I’m so excited to describe it to someone 🎨 Thanks in advance!! Contact via replies or DM.

author: nrfrh_azn
title: Looking for illustrator for YA fantasy novel
content: 🎨 Calling all fantasy illustrators! I’m looking for an illustrator for my upcoming YA fantasy novel. Think dark academia, ancient magic, mysterious towers and an elegant, atmospheric fantasy aesthetic. ✨ If you create fantasy book covers, I’d love to see your portfolio! Please DM me your artwork, rates and estimated turnaround time. Recommendations are welcome too! #FantasyIllustration #BookCoverArtist #YAFantasy

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists for book box projects through 2026

author: Rian
title: Artists wanted for potential upcoming projects
content: ARTISTS WANTED — OPEN TO NEW OPPORTUNITIES 🎨 I’m currently searching for talented artists to connect with for potential upcoming projects and creative opportunities. I’m interested in meeting people with a range of artistic skills, from digital illustration and character design to traditional artwork and other visual styles.
